subject.title: Improve context overflow error message with specifics

question: Which diagnostic fields may be shown to end users across channels, and should the initial scope stop at terminal overflow errors rather than add early-warning and trajectory-size notifications?
rationale: The implementation can carry facts already computed by the runtime, but channel visibility, redaction, and the trust level of token estimates are product and privacy decisions.

options.title: Approve a minimal redacted formatter
options.body: Show a safe display label, model identity, effective budget, and explicitly estimated overage only on unrecoverable overflow paths; defer proactive notifications.

options.title: Include proactive observability
options.body: Add threshold and post-compaction notices as part of this work, with a separately specified channel and noise policy.

options.title: Keep diagnostics log-only
options.body: Retain current user recovery text and improve operator logging/status output instead of exposing runtime details in chats.

recommendation.title: Approve a minimal redacted formatter
recommendation.body: Show a safe display label, model identity, effective budget, and explicitly estimated overage only on unrecoverable overflow paths; defer proactive notifications.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent ownership signals span the runner, compaction, and auto-reply surfaces that would need a consistent contract.
